charts.title: TIC 46432937 b: orbits around TIC 46432937
charts.description: The orbits of TIC 46432937's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TIC 46432937 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Hartman et al. 2024 (2024AJ....168..202H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HARTMAN_ET_AL_2024): P 1.44044527 d

charts.title: TIC 46432937 b: its transit
charts.description: TIC 46432937 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (98) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 46432937, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 5-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 5-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
